description: The file defines the EmployeeAttendanceSummaryListModel class, which encapsulates a collection of employee attendance records and provides a method to convert these records into an array suitable for serialization or further processing.

classes.name: EmployeeAttendanceSummaryListModel
classes.description: Represents a list of employee attendance summaries, providing transformation of raw record data into a structured array for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with an array of employee attendance records.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the list of attendance records into an array format, computing hours, minutes, and formatted label for each record.
